name: DetailTicket
title: Blocks/Detail/DetailTicket
summary: The support agent's view of one ticket, as in Zendesk Agent Workspace, a Freshdesk ticket or a Help Scout conversation. A `PageHeader` carries the subject as the h1, the ticket number, the status `Tag`, a `PriorityTag` and the next SLA as a `Countdown` (paused while Pending or On hold), and its actions: the teammates who have the ticket open (an `Avatar` with presence each and Sam Lee is viewing), Merge and a More menu (Copy link, Print, Mark as spam, Delete ticket). The main column is a `MessageThread` of the conversation (customer emails with attachments and quoted text, agent replies, internal notes, system events, the middle of a long thread collapsed behind Show N earlier messages) over the composer: a `ToggleGroup` of Reply and Internal note, the To line and a Cc `MultiSelect` for a reply, a warning-edged card that says Only your team can see internal notes for a note, a `MarkdownEditor` with @mentions of teammates, and in its footer Attach files, Insert response (saved replies), the attached files and a `SplitButton` Send with Send and set Pending and Send and set Solved (Add note for a note); files dropped on the composer attach through a `FileDropzone`. The side column, under the thread on narrow screens, holds the ticket's properties (`Field` and `Select` for status, priority, type, group and the assignee with their `Avatar`, and a `MultiSelect` of tags), the requester card (avatar, name, email, organization, other tickets and View customer profile) and the ticket's activity as a small `Timeline`. A failed load is a danger `Alert` with Retry; a failed send keeps the draft and shows an `Alert` with Retry in the composer; a solved ticket replaces the composer with Reopen. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The ticket is loading: the header shows Ticket with a placeholder line, the thread, the properties, the requester and the activity show their skeletons and the composer is disabled.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The ticket could not load: the header stays and a danger Alert with Retry takes the page body's place.

variants.name: Sending
variants.summary: A reply is on its way: Send spins, the editor is read-only and the composer is marked busy, with the draft still in view.

variants.name: SendError
variants.summary: The reply was not sent: the composer keeps the draft and shows a danger Alert with Retry above the editor.

variants.name: Solved
variants.summary: A solved ticket: the status Tag reads Solved, the SLA countdown is gone and the composer gives way to This ticket is solved with Reopen.

variants.name: InternalNote
variants.summary: The composer on Internal note: the warning edge, the lock line Only your team can see internal notes, no recipients, a draft that mentions a teammate and Add note in place of Send.
